# task-3c961022: overlap across a divider

A uniform straight divider (vertical or horizontal) separates two equal-size panels. Exclude the divider, compare corresponding coordinates between the panels, and write color 2 iff both corresponding cells are non-background; otherwise write 0. Output dimensions match one panel. Panel colors and background may vary by instance; determine the actual background from the grid. Do not mark coincident background cells.

## Evidence
- Accepted test: 22x9; color-5 divider at column 5, separating two 4-column panels (left color 1, right background 0 with sparse color-6 markers). Output 22x4, with color 2 only where a nonzero left-panel cell aligned with a nonzero right-panel cell: rows 2, 13, and 19 at output columns 1, 4, and 3 respectively (1-indexed). All other cells 0. Confirmed accepted.
- Demo: 17x5 input; color-4 vertical divider at column 3; two 2-column panels. Output 17x2. At row 5 both corresponding panel cells were nonzero (7 aligned with 5) and both output cells became 2. At row 16 one aligned pair was nonzero and output only that position was 2. Non-overlapping nonzeros produced 0.
- Accepted test: 20x9; color-6 divider at column 5; two 4-column panels, left color 4 and right color 3. Output 20x4 with color 2 exactly at coordinate-wise intersections of nonzero cells. Confirmed accepted.
- Accepted test: 4x9; color-9 divider at column 5, separating two 4-column panels. This instance had mixed zero/nonzero cells in both panels. Output 4x4 marked 2 exactly at coordinate-wise positions where both panel entries were nonzero; all other positions were 0. Confirmed accepted.
- Accepted test: 29x18 input with full-width row-15 divider color 8, creating two 14x18 panels (upper color 5, lower color 4; background 0). Output 14x18 using 2 at exact coordinate intersections where both cells were nonzero, otherwise 0. Confirms larger horizontal case and full-panel correspondence. Confirmed accepted.

## Additional accepted evidence: horizontal divider
- Accepted test: 27x8 input with a full-width row-14 divider of color 9. It separates two 13x8 panels: upper panel background 0 with occupied color-1 cells, lower panel background 0 with occupied color-3 cells. Output is 13x8, using 2 exactly where both panels are non-background at the same (row, column), and 0 elsewhere. Confirms the horizontal orientation and that differing foreground colors are treated identically.

## Procedure
1. Find the uniform divider: full-height for vertical splits or full-width for horizontal splits.
2. Split the cells on either side into equal-size panels, excluding the divider.
3. For each matching coordinate, output 2 iff both corresponding cells are non-background; otherwise output 0.
4. Preserve the panel-axis length; output dimensions equal one panel. Validate exact overlaps and row/column alignment carefully.
